title: R²Adapter：面向高效混合RAG的路由与重写适配器
summary: R²Adapter是一种轻量级插件式适配器，用于在传统RAG与基于图的RAG之间动态分配查询。它仅路由真正需要图推理的查询，减少图检索开销，并重写不确定的图路由查询以提升检索质量。在三个多跳QA基准上，图RAG使用率降低59%，同时保持准确率，且模型无关，易于集成。
summary_en: R²Adapter is a lightweight plug-in adapter that dynamically allocates queries between vanilla and graph-based RAG. It routes only queries benefiting from graph reasoning, reducing overhead, and rewrites uncertain graph-routed queries to improve retrieval. On three multi-hop QA benchmarks, it cuts graph RAG usage by up to 59% while maintaining accuracy, and is model-agnostic.
